title: A turn around one bond
hook: Rotate one carbon and compare what changes.

knows: Single bonds can rotate; atoms connected by bonds remain connected.
doesNotKnow: In ethane the eclipsed conformation is about 12 kJ/mol higher in potential energy than the staggered conformation.

misconception: Rotation changes which atoms are connected or all conformations have the same energy.
objective: Relate a 60° rotation of ethane to the staggered and eclipsed conformations.

claims.text: Question, diagram, and explanation: Starting from staggered ethane, what happens to its potential energy when the rear carbon turns 60° to the eclipsed position? In ethane the eclipsed conformation is about 12 kJ/mol higher in potential energy than the staggered conformation.
Recall: Which ethane conformation is lower in potential energy? In ethane the eclipsed conformation is about 12 kJ/mol higher in potential energy than the staggered conformation.

recall.question: Which ethane conformation is lower in potential energy?
recall.why: In ethane the eclipsed conformation is about 12 kJ/mol higher in potential energy than the staggered conformation.
